rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dropped_DLL {
    meta:

        author = "SOC_Team"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890"

        $beacon_config = { 24 00 30 00 30 00 00 00 } // Common Beacon config marker
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 6.0; Windows NT 5.1; SV1)" ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $beacon_config and $http_get and $user_agent
}
